newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 4,927.6 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 4,927.6 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 1,762.3 million Swiss francs to 4.93 billion in the reporting period ended December 31.
Statement of January 3 in millions of Swiss francs:
Lombard borrowing rose by 710.7 million francs to 764.2 million, while borrowing via discount facility and money market certificate swaps fell 1,704.5 million to 1,581.7 million.

An SNB spokesman said despite high levels of sight deposits, banks still borrowed a large amount via the relatively expensive Lombard in the year-end period, indicating they were unable to get enough funds through normal channels.
There were certain distribution problems during the period which resulted in some tension in interest rates. But at the end of the period these tensions had abated.
